leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of OAuth2 configuration parameters.
Implement cryptographic functions to generate a secure random code verifier using the Web Crypto API.
Utilize base64 encoding to transform the code verifier into a code challenge according to PKCE specifications.
Construct URL parameters to build the authorization endpoint URL with required OAuth2 PKCE parameters.
Control browser navigation to redirect users to the authorization server using the constructed URL.
Handle URL parsing to extract authorization code and state parameters from the callback redirect.
Execute HTTP POST requests to exchange the authorization code for an access token at the token endpoint.
Store authentication tokens securely using browser storage mechanisms with proper error handling.
Define React state hooks to manage authentication status and user information throughout the application.
Implement conditional rendering to display different UI components based on authentication state.
Invoke token validation functions to check token expiration and initiate refresh flows when needed.
Apply error handling patterns to manage OAuth2 flow failures and provide user feedback.
lessonTitle: OAuth2 PKCE Flow in a SPA
